name: Garden -Kyouki no Hakoniwa-
source:
The young boy collapsed in the woods. 
His memories were lost. 
It seemed he was now the live-in servant of a grand estate. 
To get his memories back he continued this work... but 
strange things are afoot in this home... 

Mystery x crossdressing R-18 original novel! 
Fully voiced characters with ON/OFF! 
A dark tale full of erotica. 

Art: Reiru Sayano 
Scenario: KANZAKI 
Voice: Katsuki Kanzaki, Rio Kisaka, Sasa Toun, Kaname Sekimoto, Shitake

Warning: lots of otoko no ko, lesbian-style scenes.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077534.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
年幼的少年倒在了森林深处，
失去了所有的记忆。
回过神来时，他似乎成了一座宏伟庄园里的住家男仆。
为了找回遗失的记忆，他留在这里继续工作……然而，
这座宅邸之中正悄然发生着诡异的怪事……

悬疑×女装题材R-18原创视觉小说！
角色全程语音（支持ON/OFF开关）！
一曲弥漫着浓郁色气的暗黑物语。

原画：Reiru Sayano
剧本：KANZAKI
配音：神崎克树、Rio Kisaka、Sasa Toun、Kaname Sekimoto、Shitake

注意：本作包含大量伪娘及百合风亲热描写。
